_readme: Copy to config/company.json (setup.ps1 does this for you). company.json is never committed. No passwords, keys or URLs here: secrets are saved with Windows DPAPI by connect_apps_script.ps1 / set_secret.ps1. Who receives each email is set in the Google Sheet's Settings tab, not here.

appfolio._sync_reports: Empty = only the reports your enabled modules use. AppFolio allows 500 report runs a day per login (resets at midnight Eastern), shared by every PC on that login; each sync runs one per report. Choices: properties, tenants, rent-roll, vacancies, vendors, rental-applications, income-statement.

leasing._comment: Reminder timing, recipients and wording are set in the Google Sheet. These control what the bridge reads.
leasing._smtp_only: The settings below are used only if delivery.method is not apps_script (direct SMTP mode).
leasing.reminder_subject: Reminder: your lease for {unit} is waiting for your signature
leasing.reminder_intro: Your lease is ready and waiting for your electronic signature.

email._comment: Only for direct SMTP mode (delivery.method other than apps_script). Apps Script sends from the Google account that owns the sheet.
